purpose: Test whether official 2000-vs-2015/2022 breeding seabird census source includes stable comparable colony/site and species identifiers appropriate for independent macro-island occupancy dynamics; do not infer colonization from aggregate species trends.

official_source.dataset_label: Seabird 2000 and Seabirds Count comparative dataset, corrected 11 July 2024
official_source.embargo_sensitive_species: Public comparative workbook might omit or suppress protected breeding seabirds; do not infer zero from suppression

pre_biological_metadata_allowed: Original XLSX ZIP file structure and SHA256
Worksheet names, dimensions, sharedStrings size and top source-authored schema/header labels
Worksheet row/column counts without displaying census counts
Whether site/colony identity, taxon, region, grid reference, count-type and census wave fields are visibly present
Whether workbook contains macros, external links or hidden worksheets
prohibited_before_design_freeze: Row-by-row species abundance/count values from either wave
Island effects, geo selected subsets, species subset p-values, habitat topology features
Synthetic assignment of census absence to an unlisted/sensitive/nonvisited colony
prospective_next_design_gates: Confirm that the published file contains a stable site or colony key across both waves; otherwise STOP two-wave spatial colonization inference
Separate complete census/colony visit records from only positive breeding records and confidential suppression
Freeze island polygon/OS grid crosswalk independently from species-level response, including continental vs oceanic geological classification
Investigate whether comparable complete counts exist per species, site and wave before comparing true occupied/not-occupied state
Treat 2000-versus-2020 as TWO historical windows, not an annual survival/recolonization series
Control for detection method changes, site mergers/splits, survey units (pairs vs adults/nests), availability of true zero, and documented species censoring
Primary comparisons require multiple independent archipelagos and holdout at archipelago unit, not more rows from same colony
